steadyview.config.title: Steady View Settings
steadyview.config.stepAngle.tooltip: How far the view turns per key press or screen-edge turn. The view snaps to multiples of this angle. Only divisors of 90 can be chosen, so you can always face the four cardinal directions, level, straight up and straight down.
steadyview.config.playerOpacity.tooltip: Opacity of your own body and the armor, elytra and cape you wear in third-person view (F5). Lower it to see through them. Held items stay opaque. Other players see you as usual.
steadyview.config.edgeTurn.off.tooltip: Moving the cursor to the screen edge does not turn the view. Use the keys to turn.
steadyview.config.edgeTurn.step.tooltip: When the cursor reaches a screen edge, the view turns by the Turn Angle in that direction. The cursor moves inward, still pointing at the same thing.
steadyview.config.edgeTurn.push.tooltip: The view turns smoothly as far as you push the cursor beyond the screen edge, and stops when the mouse stops. Set the speed with Speed (Push).
steadyview.config.edgeTurn.scroll.toolti: While the cursor is at a screen edge, the view keeps turning at a constant speed. Set the speed with Speed (Constant Speed).
steadyview.config.edgeScrollSpeed.toolti: Degrees per second the view turns when Screen Edge Turning is Constant Speed.
steadyview.config.edgePushSpeed.tooltip: How fast the view turns for how far you push the cursor when Screen Edge Turning is Push. 100% matches turning with the mouse at Minecraft's default sensitivity (0.15° per dot).
